performance.name: Piano — From Bass to Bells
performance.description: A 16-bar two-hand piano study at 76 BPM: bass melody, middle-register answer and exposed high-register sustain. Varied MIDI velocities, gently spread chords, dry prepiano with its existing performance controls. Four beats of closing silence; no loop.

patchDefinitions.name: Piano — prepiano
patchDefinitions.description: Sample-free prepiano piano with MIDI pitch/velocity and all ten performance controls. Sparse partial reinforcement shares spectral envelopes; compact linear-spline formulas. Yamaha-informed middle-register spectra and decay, with quieter G#5-A#5 hammer noise. Bass and high-treble character preserved. Spectral reference: Alexander Holm, Salamander Grand Piano V3 (CC BY 3.0). No recordings, rubbers or rattles.

piano_amplitude::kin.expression: 0.7 * ampdb(level) * amplitude * (0.5 + hz / (200 + (hz - 400 + abs(hz - 400)) / 8)) / (mass * (0.75 + 0.25 * stiffness) * (0.5 + 5 * position))

output_pan2::asig.expression: ((((signal * amplitude * core * contour + impact) * (1 - mix) + gain * (3.644 * body1 + 2.475 * body2 + 3.094 * body3 + 7.535 * body4 + 5.18 * body5 + 7.274 * body6))) + partial_gate * (bank0 + bank1 + bank2 + bank3)) * shape_c4

piano_partial_gate::kin.expression: (1 - (0.5 + (abs(note - 72) - abs(note - 84)) / 24)) * attack * gate * ampdb(level + 3) * strength / 30 * (0.75 + 0.25 * mass)
